[IARC.11.1] **Share-immutable / deep-copy-mutable.** The immutable-per-session
structures — the Rete network topology (`AlphaNode`/`BetaNode`/`TerminalNode` nodes, tests,
salience), the schema registry, the loaded DSC — MAY be shared read-only behind a
refcount (cheaper — they are the large parts) or copied (simplest ownership);
either conforms, but a shared owner **must** refcount so the two engines free in
any order. The mutable state **must** be
deep-copied: the fact set; the Rete memories (alpha hash-sets, beta **tokens**);
the TMS justifier table; series backings; the TTL FIFO/heap; the agenda +
refraction sets; the clock value; **the cache map** ([LSTO.4.7], mutable engine
state); **the string intern table** (deep-copied, not shared: it interns
String-typed slot values and grows at runtime, so sharing it is shared-mutable state that races the
parallel-clone use and, even serial, leaks a discarded clone's strings back into
the source). The cache copies verbatim — its
values are opaque (JSON-text keyed by string), so it needs no fact-pointer remap.
The deep-copy is a
**graph clone with fact-pointer remap** — build an `old_fact* → new_fact*` map
while copying facts, then repoint every fact reference (beta tokens, alpha/beta
memories, `FACT_REF` slots — the fact data model ([IDAT])). The intern table is re-created — content
re-interned into the clone's own fresh table — and interned-string references
remap via the resulting old→new string map.
